name: keycloak
summary: Deploys an owned local Keycloak OIDC provider without changing AAP or AO authentication automatically.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the owned namespace and local state while protecting unowned namespaces.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before deployment or deletion when cluster access or ownership validation fails.

readiness: The owned Keycloak deployment is ready and its realm is available.

security.secret_storage: Generated client secrets remain in the managed local state and must not be copied into shared config.
security.network_trust: OIDC configuration uses explicit trusted local endpoints.
security.external_actions: Authentication mapping requires a separate explicit configure action.
